Sandbox_ApocalypseWheelbarrows_WoodAdvan: Sets the leverage multiplier for the wooden wheelbarrow. Higher values reduce carried item weight more aggressively.
Sandbox_ApocalypseWheelbarrows_Reinforce: Sets the leverage multiplier for the reinforced wheelbarrow. Higher values reduce carried item weight more aggressively.
Sandbox_ApocalypseWheelbarrows_MetalAdva: Sets the leverage multiplier for the metal wheelbarrow. Higher values reduce carried item weight more aggressively.
Sandbox_ApocalypseWheelbarrows_WoodRecip: Required Woodwork level for crafting the wooden wheelbarrow. Set to 0 to remove the requirement.

Required Metal Welding level for crafting the wooden wheelbarrow. Set to 0 to remove the requirement.

Required Metal Welding level for crafting the metal wheelbarrow. Set to 0 to remove the requirement.
